query_interpretation.source_query: 这个ACT策略在grab_roller任务中最先会在哪种可执行物体属性或场景变化上暴露弱点？
query_interpretation.requested_variation: Shift the roller center laterally by a fixed, reachable offset toward the workspace boundary. Preserve the roller's color, material, size, shape, orientation, tabletop scene layout, camera viewpoint, task instruction, policy checkpoint, and official success semantics.
query_interpretation.sub_aspect: Robustness to a bounded lateral shift of the roller within the reachable workspace
query_interpretation.measurement_need: Compare official grab_roller success between the nominal roller center position and the laterally shifted position, while verifying that the shifted center remains inside the reachable workspace.
query_interpretation.hypothesis: The ACT policy will show a lower official-task success rate when the roller is shifted laterally toward the workspace boundary than at its nominal center position, despite the roller remaining reachable.
query_interpretation.task_intent: Grasp the roller and achieve the official grab_roller task goal.
